user.title: PowerShades
user.description:
Enter your PowerShades **RF gateway** address (local, e.g. `10.0.30.239`).

**Travel time** = how many seconds a shade takes to move fully open to fully closed. We use it to emulate "set to N%", which the gateway itself can't do (it only has up/down/stop). Default is 20s — measure yours once if you want precise positions.

channel.title: Name channel {n} of {m}
channel.description:
Channel **{n}** is linked.

**Test it**: pick *Up* or *Down* and watch which physical shade moves, then name it (e.g. `FIREPLACE`, `SIDE LEFT`). Leave the name blank to keep using the channel number.

Pick *Idle* to move to the next channel without a test.

groups.title: Groups (optional)
groups.description:
Optionally group channels to open / close them together.

One group per line, format `Name: 1,2,3`.

Example:
```
Great Room: 1,2,3
Office: 4,5
```

Leave blank for no groups.

error.gateway_unreachable: Could not reach the RF gateway. Check the address / network.
error.no_shades: Gateway is reachable but no channels report a shade linked. Link one in the gateway UI first.

init.title: PowerShades options
init.description: Update the full-travel time (used for "set to N%") and / or the group list (one line per group, `Name: 1,2,3`).
